Open the Messages app (critical)
Tap the Compose button, a square with a pencil (critical)
Add each of the three children as recipients (critical)
Type your message (critical)
Tap the Send button, an up arrow (critical)
Recipients who are not on iMessage receive the group as MMS, SMS, or RCS
To send group MMS, go to Settings, then Messages, and turn on MMS Messaging; if the option is missing, contact the carrier
unsupported_claims: "All three will get your message." -> the page says Messages picks the message type from settings, connection, and carrier plan, and does not explicitly guarantee delivery to every recipient

"If one of your kids has an Android phone and the message won't send, go to Settings, then Messages, and make sure MMS Messaging is turned on." -> the page never mentions Android; it says MMS Messaging is needed for group MMS on iPhone, and that if the option is missing the carrier should be contacted
reasons: Two closing claims are not on the source page (guaranteed delivery to all three; an Android-specific failure). The MMS note also drops the carrier fallback.
fix: Delete the sentence "All three will get your message." Replace the Android sentence with: "If a recipient is not on iMessage, the group is sent as MMS, SMS, or RCS. To send group MMS on iPhone, go to Settings, then Messages, and turn on MMS Messaging. If you don't see that option, contact your carrier to check whether your plan supports Group MMS Messaging." Source: https://support.apple.com/en-us/118236

required_actions: Open Google Maps and make sure you're signed in (critical)
Tap your profile picture or initial (critical)
Tap Location sharing, then New share (critical)
Choose how long to share (critical)
Choose the son; allow contacts access if asked (critical)
Tap Share (critical)
Without a Gmail account: tap Copy to clipboard instead of steps 6 and 7, then paste the link into a text or email
The link shares your real-time location for up to 24 hours
reasons: The no-Gmail option says "you can share a link instead" but gives no action; the page's action is to tap Copy to clipboard in place of the contact and Share steps.
fix: Replace "If he doesn't use Gmail, you can share a link instead, which works for up to 24 hours." with: "If he doesn't use Gmail, skip steps 6 and 7. Instead, tap Copy to clipboard, then paste the link into a text or email to him. Anyone with the link can see your location for up to 24 hours." Source: https://support.google.com/maps/answer/15437054?hl=en&co=GENIE.Platform%3DAndroid

unsupported_claims: "You can remove most of them." -> the page does not say how many preinstalled apps can be removed; it says some system apps cannot be removed
"most apps can be removed through the Play Store like this" -> the page covers uninstalling apps you installed; the 'most' is not on the page
"can only be turned off, not deleted" -> the page says some system apps cannot be removed and that on certain phones you can turn them off, not that turning off is the only option

Sources: https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/13627402?hl=en and https://support.google.com/googleplay/answer/13627571?hl=en
